title: Borrowing from the Tool Library
transcript: If you're new to the tool library, gather round the front desk and I'll show you how borrowing works. Once we've set up your membership, we'll give you a yellow card. Bring it whenever you come to collect something, even if you've reserved it online. To see what's available today, check the wall chart beside the desk. We update it as tools go out and come back. For tools that come with accessories, you'll get a canvas bag to keep the smaller pieces together. Check the contents with us before you go. If you need a tool for longer than you planned, give us a ring. We can extend the loan if nobody else has booked it. And when you bring a tool back, please hand it to a member of staff so we can record the return straight away.

questions.prompt: Item to bring when collecting tools: yellow ____
questions.explanation: 办好会员手续后会领到一张黄卡，每次来取工具都要带上。
服务台旁的挂表会随工具借出和归还而更新。
带配件的工具会配一个帆布袋，用来收纳小零件。

questions.prompt: When can a loan be extended?
options: When the borrower reserved the tool online.
When the borrower collected the tool that morning.
When nobody else has booked the tool.
questions.answer: When nobody else has booked the tool.
questions.explanation: 如果没有其他人预订这件工具，借用期限就可以延长。

questions.prompt: How should borrowers return a tool?
options: Hand it directly to a member of staff.
Put it back on the shelf where it was stored.
Leave it in a return box outside.
questions.answer: Hand it directly to a member of staff.
questions.explanation: 归还工具时要直接交给工作人员，以便当场登记。
